failure_signature: The first LF-preserving validation clone fetched the exact commit but its checkout rejected two inherited historical document filenames under the default Windows Git path-length policy.
trigger_preconditions: fresh Windows checkout includes inherited filenames beyond the default Git path limit
clone-time LF preservation exposes a complete new checkout path
recovery: Create one fresh named validation clone with Git long-path support and LF preservation enabled only for that clone operation, then require a clean exact-head checkout before validation.
recurrence_guard: Audit inherited maximum path length before Windows materialization and set clone-local Git checkout policy before the first checkout; do not enable an operating-system feature or rewrite filenames without explicit migration authority.
promotion_effect: The incomplete clone is rejected and no validator or test result from it is promoted.
boundary: This is a Windows materialization negative. It is not scientific, security-certification, legal, cultural, identity, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction evidence.
